prompts.animPrompt-sheep:
PRODUCTION 8-DIRECTION WALK ANIMATION SPRITESHEET, one character only, for GOAT OUT.
The reference image defines exact character identity, art style, colors, costume and overhead camera. Match its detailed illustrated pixel painting and dark contours. This is NOT a redesign.
OUTPUT LAYOUT IS MANDATORY: exactly FOUR columns and EIGHT rows of equally sized square cells, aspect ratio 1:2, 1024x2048 output preferred, exactly 32 full-body sprites. No extra row, no footer, no border, no text, no labels. Every sprite isolated on a perfectly uniform solid CHROMA KEY MAGENTA #ff00ff background for automatic atlas packing. No checkerboard, no gradient, no floor, no drop shadow, no atmospheric haze. Magenta is background only and must not occur inside the character.
Each cell 256x256, use a consistent body scale, character occupies approximately 160x185 pixels with generous empty margin. SAME pelvis/body-root position at cell (128,155); ground/foot plane near y=218 for humanoids and 205 for animals. No frame is enlarged to fill its cell. The body must not drift between frames. Keep weapons, tails, horns and flame inside cell.
ROW DIRECTIONS IN EXACT TOP-TO-BOTTOM ORDER:
Row 1 SOUTH: facing straight DOWN toward viewer, symmetrically front-facing at overhead camera.
Row 2 SOUTHWEST: facing diagonally DOWN-LEFT.
Row 3 WEST: facing straight LEFT.
Row 4 NORTHWEST: facing diagonally UP-LEFT.
Row 5 NORTH: facing straight UP away from viewer; see back of head/body, no front face.
Row 6 NORTHEAST: facing diagonally UP-RIGHT.
Row 7 EAST: facing straight RIGHT.
Row 8 SOUTHEAST: facing diagonally DOWN-RIGHT, same direction as front reference.
ALL are genuine orientation drawings of the SAME creature, not whole-image rotations or just two mirrored angles. North and south must be distinctly different from diagonals. Camera fixed high three-quarter overhead, see top of back and head.
WITHIN EACH ROW, the FOUR columns are consecutive looping WALK frames:
1 left-front/right-rear contact, 2 passing under body, 3 opposite contact, 4 opposite passing returning into frame1.
Draw real different LEG POSITIONS in every frame, feet lift/plant alternately. Torso shape, face, gear, horns and color identity remain stable. Small natural body bob only, no whole-body squash-as-walk. Animation must loop 1→2→3→4→1 without a jump. Four frames per facing, eight facings.
Fine hand-painted pixel texture, shaded wool/cloth/leather, confident silhouette, no high-res noise. Preserve all original recognizable details.
CHARACTER: the small weak SHEEP from the reference. Scruffy cream/off-white wool, gray charcoal muzzle, worried dark eyes, long drooping gray ears, skinny dark legs with cloven hooves, tiny ochre neck cord, two short ochre-beige horns slightly larger than original buds. Same little tuft on forehead. No armor, no monstrous horns, no beard. Do not make it a powerful stocky ram. In every walk cycle animate all FOUR LEGS with alternating diagonal pairs and visible short TAIL WAG: left in frame1, neutral frame2, right frame3, neutral frame4. Tail especially visible from N/NW/NE and profiles; from south it can peek at the rear edge. Do not swap tail with horns. Keep horns fixed to skull and ears bob only a little.

prompts.assetPrompt-fire:
Create an ANIMATED FIRE PRODUCTION ATLAS matching the illustrated pixel art of the provided object reference. Three separate 8-frame loops, exactly EIGHT COLUMNS and THREE ROWS, 24 square cells, overall aspect ratio 8:3. Uniform solid pure MAGENTA #ff00ff background for chroma-key export; no checkerboard or floor. No text or borders. Same object scale and stationary body position in every frame of a row.
ROW 1: the exact squat iron-basket BRAZIER from reference, each cell has the full complete brazier and fire. The iron bowl, slats, legs and coal-bed remain absolutely identical at the same pixel coordinates; ONLY flames and two tiny embers animate.
ROW 2: a wooden wall TORCH with wrapped cloth head in a dark iron wall bracket, full torch visible, no wall. Same wooden shaft, wrapping and bracket stay stationary; only flame animates.
ROW 3: the reference OIL LANTERN ON SHORT STAND, full base and post, dark frame and amber glass. Frame, post, glass outline and base remain stationary; the interior flame dances and amber illumination varies mildly. Not a different lantern in each cell.
Across each row, columns1–8 are eight successive LOOPING FLAME frames. Column1 small center rising tongue,2 leans left,3 left lick splits into two,4 higher central plume,5 bends right,6 right tongue splits,7 lower curled flame,8 flows back toward frame1. Real changing flame silhouettes with yellow-white core, orange mid-flame, dark amber outer edge. Fire never goes out, no huge brightness jumps, no object warping, no zoom.
Keep object foot/base centered at x50%, y87% in each cell; fire has safe space above. No flame or ember crosses a cell border. Rich hand-painted pixel texture, dark outlines, identical angle and light as reference, tops and short front sides visible, top-down gameplay assets. Sprite details around 100–140px, output with enough resolution for clean packing.

prompts.assetPrompt-doors:
Create a DOOR-STATE ATLAS for the illustrated pixel-art cult dungeon in the reference. EXACTLY 4 COLUMNS x 4 ROWS =16 individual sprites, square canvas. No walls or stone frames: ONLY door leaves with their metal hinge fittings. Fixed high three-quarter top-down camera, visibly see top edge and face of the door, matching room reference.
Rows are 4 distinct door types:
row1 weathered WOOD PLANK DOOR, rough brown boards, dark iron cross bands, ring handle.
row2 heavy IRON DOOR, dark worn steel, rivets and iron bands.
row3 VAULT DOOR, same heavy iron but with a small pale-gold soul crest and brass details.
row4 SOUL GATE, same heavy iron but with a narrow violet seal and icy pale-blue wisp emblem, not a big magical portal.
Columns are FOUR STATES of each SAME door:
col1 CLOSED intact leaf,
col2 OPENING about 45 degrees on its hinge,
col3 FULLY OPEN about 90 degrees, foreshortened leaf with edge clearly visible,
col4 BROKEN leaf with matching wood or metal debris lying flat, no intact door left.
Every state keeps same hinge pivot location at 28% cell width,80% cell height; opening is a perspective hinge turn, not a flat image rotation. Ensure clear distinct closed/open/open90/broken appearance. Each entire object fits with margin in its own equal square cell. Source-style painted wood grain, chipped iron, depth and restrained light; NO text, no numbers, no grid, no doorframe, no room, no floor shadow. PURE SOLID MAGENTA #ff00ff background for alpha packing. Detailed painted pixel art, not crude vector rectangles.
prompts.assetPrompt-objects:
Create a PRODUCTION OBJECT ATLAS for the exact illustrated pixel-art cult dungeon in reference. EXACTLY 4 COLUMNS x 4 ROWS=16 isolated sprites in equal square cells on PURE SOLID MAGENTA #ff00ff background. No text, labels, grid, room or background floor. Same high three-quarter top-down camera, same dark outlines, muted warm stone, worn timber and plum iron, fine painted pixel texture.
ROW1 left to right:
1 short segment of CAGE FENCE: three dark iron vertical bars connected by two horizontal rails, full feet and top rivets, reusable segment with no animals.
2 SAME fence segment bent and broken after a blow, one snapped bar and tilted rail.
3 a ROUND STONE MILL HUB with dark iron central axle hole, worn grooves, seen almost directly overhead. Hub only, no arms.
4 a SINGLE LONG WOODEN MILL ARM with iron bands, blunt heavy metal cap and dull red stain at end, isolated horizontal beam seen from above. No hub.
ROW2:
1 SPIKE TRAP PLATE idle: square sunk dark steel grating, four empty narrow slots, corner bolts, no extended spikes.
2 SAME trap plate arming: tiny warm amber metal-edge highlights, slots beginning to show tips, no glow aura.
3 SAME plate fully raised: four clearly extended polished iron spikes, dangerous silhouette, same base size and angle.
4 EMPTY WOODEN WEAPON RACK: two crossed feet and a horizontal support rail, no weapons on it.
ROW3:
1 simple long IRON SWORD with leather/wood grip and brass guard, diagonal isolated.
2 ROUND WOODEN SHIELD with iron rim and central boss, worn narrow violet painted stripe.
3 HEALING GRASS PATCH: small vivid pale-green grass tufts, a few tiny cream buds, irregular loose grass silhouette without a square dirt tile, not a food bowl.
4 CORRUPTED SOUL WISP: compact violet outer flame around icy-blue bright core and tiny dark face slits, no circular halo, no book or skull.
ROW4:
1 SECRET-WALL PATCH: a single square of dark plum masonry matching room wall texture, subtle hairline crack around one stone, NOT a bright door or obvious symbol. This one cell is a square opaque tile.
2 BROKEN CRATE DEBRIS: loose splintered brown boards and iron nail heads, compact flat pile.
3 UNLIT BRAZIER: the same squat slatted iron basket from reference but with dark cold coals and absolutely no fire. Complete feet/bowl.
4 PLAIN WORK TABLE: rough wooden planks, short legs and one iron band; no altar cloth, candles or skull.
Every item fully inside central78% of its cell, consistent scale within related state families, especially all3 spike plates and2 cage segments. Avoid unrelated props and detail clutter. Assets should look lifted from the reference room, not simplified placeholders.
